$comment: Schema pin declaration for state/quality-trend/** and state/pdca/**-quality-trend.pdca.json artifacts in Demerzel. Phase 0 deliverable #5 of ga/docs/plans/2026-05-14-arch-cherny-adoption-and-tribunal-ci-plan-v2.md.

pins.qa_verdict_schema: ga/docs/contracts/qa-verdict.schema.json (vendored upstream — Demerzel is the canonical consumer / aggregator)

policy.scope: Quality-trend JSONL entries appended AFTER this file's git introduction are considered pinned to these versions. Pre-existing entries in 2026-05.jsonl are implicitly draft/v0.
policy.bump_rule: Demerzel is the cross-repo coordinator. On OPTIC-K or qa_verdict_schema bump, this file MUST be updated FIRST (before ga / ix / tars sidecars) so the tribunal can refuse to aggregate verdicts that reference outdated pins.
policy.jsonl_note: Optional: appending a header line {"_schema":{...}} to 2026-05.jsonl is permitted (v2 plan literal text) but not required — consumers reading the JSONL should fall back to this sidecar for the canonical pin set.
